stories.title: Kawhi Leonard Trade Frozen — Dillon Brooks Says 'It Won't Happen'

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Dillon Brooks told a streamer on July 31: the Kawhi Leonard trade to Toronto "won't happen."

The NBA investigation may now extend into 2027.

Raptors won't accept penalty risk. Clippers say they're victims.

Kawhi's $50.3M salary. Zero clarity. 🕐

#LAClippers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The Kawhi trade to Toronto was agreed June 30.

It is August 4. Still frozen.

• NBA probe: no resolution
• NBPA arbitration: possible
• Season deadline: now in doubt
• Kawhi's future: unknown

Most complicated NBA case in years. 🔒

#Raptors #LAClippers
